SandboxProcessStage.name: SandboxProcessStage
SandboxProcessStage.description: Represents the status and progress during a spectific stage for a SandboxProcess record.

SandboxProcess.description: Indicates the sandbox process that this progress belongs to.

StageNumber.description: Indicates the order of the stages.

Status.description: Indicates whether the stage has completed or not.

StartTime.description: When the stage's status goes into In Progress.

EndTime.description: When the stage's status goes into Completed.

InfoLastUpdated.description: When we last checked the internal system for progress information on this stage.

CompletedWork.description: Indicates the current amount of work completed.

ActualTotalWork.description: Indicates the verified amount of work to be completed. This number calculates continuously and may represent a partial amount while IsActualWorkFinal=false.

IsActualWorkFinal.description: Default false, set to true after calculation of the actual work completes.

EstimatedTotalWork.description: During the In Queue stage, this represents the number of sandboxes ahead of yours.
